'''Bivall''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Protobranch/Legends|Protobranch]].<ref name="SWFF7" />

==Biology and description==
Bivall were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in form with blue/maroon skin, similar in appearance to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] had a slender body, a long thin neck and a crested head with [[Eye/Legends|eye]] stalks.

==History==
Bivall were known to have taken both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] sides. Dr. [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]] was an alien scientist working for the Republic (performing research on the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]), while [[Okalin/Legends|Okalin]] was the royal advisor of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], the selfish and arrogant ruler of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
